proposals.rationale: SC-001's spec text asserted 'no comparative benchmark exists in the repo' and that SC-001 was unverifiable. This is false: apps/eviction-replay-benchmark (workspace member, Cargo.toml:43,75) replays a real multi-turn Qwen-Bailian trace through both eviction-policy-session-lists and eviction-policy-lru and reports per-policy hit-rate at configurable cache sizes (src/sim.rs:148-206, src/replay.rs:117-144, src/main.rs, tests/replay_hits.rs). It first appeared in c247b890 (2026-08-04), the component's own introducing commit, and was missed by the 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-20 syncs which inspected only benches/session_list_benchmark.rs. The eviction code itself is correct (FR-001..FR-018, SC-002..SC-006 aligned) so this is spec-lag -> BACKFILL. SC-001 is measurable, and the sampled results show the >=15% target is real-but-unmet and workload/cache-size dependent (chat trace cache 256: session-lists 8.2% vs LRU 7.2%); rewritten to say so honestly.
proposals.before: SC-001 (design goal - not a measured outcome; downgraded 2026-08-07, re-verified 2026-08-20): ...no such comparative benchmark exists in the repo... Until such a harness exists, the >=15% figure remains a design target... Building that harness is tracked in align-tasks.md Task 1.
proposals.after: SC-001 (design goal - measurable via the comparative harness, but not met at the >=15% target on sampled runs; corrected 2026-09-02): ...A comparative trace-replay harness DOES exist: apps/eviction-replay-benchmark... reports per-policy hit-rate... existed since the introducing commit and was overlooked by prior syncs... measured effect is workload/cache-size dependent and does NOT reach >=15%... target is aspirational-and-unmet, now measurable rather than unverifiable.
